acquisition_method: The Orbitrap Astral was operated in data-independent acquisition (DIA) mode, with MS1 scans conducted in the Orbitrap at a resolution of 240,000 and a maximum injection time of 5 ms across a range of 380–980 m/z.
alkylation_concentration: Next, samples were treated with 10 mM of iodoacetamide in the dark for 30 min at room temperature.
alkylation_reagent: Next, samples were treated with 10 mM of iodoacetamide in the dark for 30 min at room temperature.
cleavage_agent: Proteins were digested overnight at 37 °C with trypsin.
collision_energy: HCD collision energy was maintained at 25%, and normalized AGC was set to 500%.
fragmentation_method: HCD collision energy was maintained at 25%, and normalized AGC was set to 500%.
instrument: Peptides were loaded onto a 75 µm × 2 cm trap column (Thermo Fisher) before re-focusing on an IonOpticks Aurora Elite 75 um × 15 cm C18 column using a Vanquish Neo UHPLC (Thermo Fisher), connected to an Orbitrap Astral mass spectrometer (Thermo Fisher).
mass_analyzer: DIA MS2 scans were carried out in the Astral mass analyzer with a maximum injection time of 3 ms, utilizing a variable windowing strategy, including 2 Da windows from 380 to 680 m/z, 4 Da windows from 680 to 800 m/z, and 8 Da windows from 800 to 980 m/z.
ptm: Parameters for precursor ion generation were set as follows: a maximum of 1 missed cleavage, up to 1 variable modification for Ox(M), peptide lengths ranging from 6 to 30, precursor charge within 2–4, precursor m/z ranging from 380 to 980, and fragment m/z ranging from 150 to 2000.
reduction_concentration: Briefly, 25 µg of protein per sample were treated with dithiothreitol (2 mM) and incubated at 55 °C for 60 min.
reduction_reagent: Briefly, 25 µg of protein per sample were treated with dithiothreitol (2 mM) and incubated at 55 °C for 60 min.
